attempts.summary: Deployed PostgreSQL 13 streaming replication across node1 (primary), node2 and node3 (standbys) on RHEL9. Demonstrated full failover: stopped node1, promoted node2 to writable primary with zero data loss, repointed node3 to node2, and rejoined the recovered former primary (node1) as a standby of node2 via fresh pg_basebackup. Then executed the mandatory one-at-a-time reboot protocol on all three nodes (standbys first, primary last), verifying changed boot_id and full replication/quorum recovery after each restart, finishing with an end-to-end write propagated to all nodes.
